title: game/data/uiTheme.json: the UI's look (UI track: UI-1 made it, UI-3 version 2 for the Studio's UI section)
description: Boot writes it as CSS variables (game/js/logic/ui-theme.js); without it the page keeps tokens.css. defaults is the look; a preset lays some groups over it (the Studio applies one onto the defaults or a screen); overrides lay colour and shape over the defaults on one screen. Version 2 (UI-3): every group the Studio's dials edit, the defaults equal to tokens.css and base.css (v05.css until UI-6).

surface.description: solid cards and the glass's colour (--panel-s, --g-solid, --g-bg)

danger.description: (--red); left out: the colour code's red (signals, the side's bad shade)

hpOk.description: healthy HP; left out (UI-12): the colour code's teal (good)

hpMid.description: HP under half; left out (UI-12): the colour code's amber (caution)

hpLow.description: HP under a quarter; left out (UI-12): the colour code's red (bad)

mapGrass.description: UI-12: the minimap's grass, mixed into the surface (left out: primary)

mapWater.description: UI-12: the minimap's water, mixed into the surface (left out: healthy HP)

surface.description: the glass: blur and saturation for both sides, the rest per side

stepped.description: UI-2: cut corners as pixel steps instead of a smooth 45° line

step.description: UI-2: px per step when stepped

families.description: UI-2: each component family's shape; UI-3: its cut size, corners and rounded radius as data

kind.description: cut is the look; rounded and square are for comparing

size.description: which cut size the family's cuts use

corners.description: which corners are cut (the long hexagons, action and toast, cut both ends and ignore it)

radius.description: px, when the family is rounded

name.description: a preset's name in the Studio; the defaults' and a player preset's in Settings' Palette row

player.description: UI-12: a preset players pick in Settings' Palette row (checked in full, like the defaults)

highlight.description: the 1 px top highlight inside a glass panel (--g-in), its opacity

edgeHi.description: the edge line's light top on the angular parts (--edge-hi), its opacity

edgeLo.description: the edge line's dark side (--edge-lo): the shadow tint at this opacity

shadowTint.description: the shadows' colour: text (the side's text colour), or a colour

raisedY.description: raised (cards, buttons): how far down the big shadow falls, px

raisedBlur.description: raised (cards, buttons): the big shadow's blur, px

raisedAlpha.description: raised (cards, buttons): the big shadow's opacity

raisedNear.description: raised (cards, buttons): the small near shadow's opacity

floatY.description: floating (sheets, toasts, the bottom bar): how far down the big shadow falls, px

floatBlur.description: floating (sheets, toasts, the bottom bar): the big shadow's blur, px

floatAlpha.description: floating (sheets, toasts, the bottom bar): the big shadow's opacity

floatNear.description: floating (sheets, toasts, the bottom bar): the small near shadow's opacity

depth.description: the three depths (flat, raised, floating) of the glass panels' box shadows (--g-sh, --g-sh2), per side; flat has none

drop.description: the angular parts' drop shadows (--drop-raised, --drop-float), in the shadow colour of each side

space.description: the spacing scale (--s1..--s7) and the screen gutter, px

motion.description: the three speeds in ms, the stagger between rows, the feedback times (UI-16a) and the eases

press.description: UI-16a: --m-press, ms: a press's squash and its spring back

exit.description: UI-16a: --m-exit, ms: things leaving (a toast, a sheet's fly-to)

pop.description: UI-16a: --m-pop, ms: a number's or a target's pop

float.description: UI-16a: --m-float, ms: a floating number's rise after its pop

minimap.description: UI-8: the bottom bar's minimap (js/minimap.js): how much it shows, when the bar goes compact, its marks

span.description: --minimap-span, metres across the tile's shorter side (top to bottom while standing)

tileW.description: UI-8b: --minimap-tile-w, the standing tile's width in px (narrow phones shrink it, keeping its shape)

tileH.description: UI-8b: --minimap-tile-h, the standing tile's height in px; it stands out of the bar's frame by about this less the bar

tileCompact.description: UI-8b: --minimap-tile-compact, the walking tile's side in px (a square)

compactAfter.description: --minimap-compact-after, ms of walking before the bar goes compact

fullAfter.description: --minimap-full-after, ms standing before it comes back

billies.description: --minimap-billies: the wild Billies out in the world

style.description: SY-8: the style track's dials (logic/style-dials.js; left out: today's numbers): the Bureau's stamp, the HP roll, the damage number's sizes, the coat foil

stampScale.description: --stamp-scale: pb-stamp's size times its page's own (sm 14 px, 22 px, lg 34 px)

stampSlant.description: --stamp-slant: degrees a stamp turns (a page's tilt of -8 turns this far)

rollMs.description: --hp-roll: ms the HP number rolls and the plate's fill moves

popMin.description: --pop-min: the damage number at a scratch, px

popMax.description: --pop-max: the damage number at a one-shot and a KO, px

foilPeriod.description: --foil-period: ms between the coat foil's sweeps

foilSweep.description: --foil-sweep: ms a sweep takes to cross the Billie

foilHalf.description: --foil-half: the band's half width (the sprite is 1.6 across along its way)

signals.description: UI-11: the colour code, the same in every palette (docs/phases/ui-track.md, "The colour code"; logic/signals.js): the eight families, the three statuses and the four rarity tiers; only the defaults set it

fill.description: tags, chips and bars on dark glass, dark text on them: --sig-<id>, both sides

light.description: the text shade on light screens: --sig-<id>-text

dark.description: the text shade on dark screens: --sig-<id>-text

allOf.description: UI-11: the colour code is the same in every palette

overrides.description: per screen: colour and shape over the defaults on that screen only (logic/ui-theme.js UI_SCREENS names each screen's root)
